ayahs.1: Ae Nabi! Allah Taala se darte rehna aur kaafiron aur munafiqon ki baaton mein na aa jaana, Allah Taala bade ilm wala aur badi hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.2: Jo kuchh aap ki jaanib aap ke Rabb ki taraf se wahi ki jaati hai us ki taabedari karen (yaqeen maano) ke Allah tumhare har ek amal se ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.3: Aap Allah hi par tawakkul rakhen, woh karsazi ke liye kaafi hai.
ayahs.4: Kisi aadmi ke seene mein Allah Taala ne do dil nahin rakhe, aur apni jin biwiyon ko tum maan keh baithte ho unhein Allah ne tumhari (sach much ki) maayen nahin banaya, aur na tumhare le-paalak ladkon ko (waqai) tumhare bete banaya hai, yeh to tumhare apne munh ki baaten hain, Allah Taala haq baat farmaata hai aur woh (seedhi) raah sujhaata hai.
ayahs.5: Le-paalakon ko un ke (haqeeqi) baapon ki taraf nisbat kar ke bulaao Allah ke nazdeek poora insaaf yehi hai. Phir agar tumhein un ke (haqeeqi) baapon ka ilm hi na ho to woh tumhare deeni bhai aur dost hain, tum se bhool-chook mein jo kuchh ho jaaye is mein tum par koi gunah nahin, albatta gunah woh hai jis ka tum irada dil se karo. Allah Taala bada hi bakhshne wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.6: Paighambar mominon par khud un se bhi zyada haq rakhne wale hain aur Paighambar ki biwiyan mominon ki maayen hain, aur rishte-daar Kitaabullah ki roo se ba-nisbat doosre mominon aur muhajiron ke aapas mein zyada haq-daar hain (haan) magar yeh ke tum apne doston ke saath husn-e-sulook karna chaaho. Yeh hukm kitaab (Ilahi) mein likha hua hai.
ayahs.7: Jabke hum ne tamaam nabiyon se ahd liya aur (bil-khusus) aap se aur Nooh se aur Ibraheem se aur Moosa se aur Maryam ke bete Eesa se, aur hum ne un se (pakka aur) pukhta ahd liya.
ayahs.8: Taake Allah Taala sachchon se un ki sachchai ke baare mein daryaft farmaaye, aur kaafiron ke liye hum ne alamnak azaab tayyar kar rakhe hain.
ayahs.9: Ae imaan walo! Allah Taala ne jo ehsaan tum par kiya use yaad karo jabke tumhare muqable ko faujon par faujen aayen phir hum ne un par tez-o-tund aandhi aur aise lashkar bheje jinhein tum ne dekha hi nahin, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho Allah Taala sab kuchh dekhta hai.
ayahs.10: Jabke (dushman) tumhare paas upar se aur neeche se chadh aaye aur jabke aankhen pathra gayin aur kaleje munh ko aa gaye aur tum Allah Taala ki nisbat tarah tarah ke gumaan karne lage.
ayahs.11: Yahin momin aazmaaye gaye aur poori tarah woh jhinjhod diye gaye.
ayahs.12: Aur is waqt munafiq aur woh log jin ke dilon mein (shak ka) rog tha kehne lage Allah Taala aur us ke Rasool ne hum se mehaz dhoka-fareb ka hi waada kiya tha.
ayahs.13: Un hi ki ek jamaat ne haank lagaai ke ae Madeena walo! Tumhare liye thikana nahin chalo laut chalo, aur un ki ek aur jamaat yeh keh kar Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam) se ijazat maangne lagi ke hamare ghar ghair-mahfooz hain, halanke woh (khule hue aur) ghair-mahfooz na the (lekin) un ka pukhta irada bhaag khade hone ka tha.
ayahs.14: Aur agar Madeene ke atraaf se un par (lashkar) daakhil kiye jaate phir un se fitna talab kiya jaata to yeh zaroor ise barpa kar dete aur na ladte magar thodi muddat.
ayahs.15: Is se pehle to unhon ne Allah se ahd kiya tha ke peeth na pherenge, aur Allah Taala se kiye hue waade ki baaz-purs zaroor hogi.
ayahs.16: Keh dijiye ke go tum maut se ya khauf-e-qatl se bhaago to yeh bhaagna tumhein kuchh bhi kaam na aayega aur is waqt tum bahut hi kam faaida uthaoge.
ayahs.17: Poochhiye! To ke agar Allah Taala tumhein koi buraai pahunchana chaahe ya tum par koi fazl karna chaahe to kaun hai jo tumhein bacha sake (ya tum se rok sake?), apne liye ba-juz Allah Taala ke na koi himayati paayenge na madadgaar.
ayahs.18: Allah Taala tum mein se unhein (ba-khoobi) jaanta hai jo doosron ko rokte hain aur apne bhai-bandhon se kehte hain ke hamare paas chale aao. Aur kabhi kabhi hi ladaai mein aa jaate hain.
ayahs.19: Tumhari madad mein (poore) bakheel hain, phir jab khauf-o-dehshat ka mauqa aa jaaye to aap unhein dekhenge ke aap ki taraf nazren jama dete hain aur un ki aankhen is tarah ghoomti hain jaise us shakhs ki jis par maut ki ghashi taari ho. Phir jab khauf jaata rehta hai to tum par apni tez zabaanon se badi baaten banaate hain maal ke bade hi harees hain, yeh imaan laaye hi nahin hain Allah Taala ne un ke tamaam aamaal naabood kar diye hain, aur Allah Taala par yeh bahut hi aasaan hai.
ayahs.20: Samajhte hain ke ab tak lashkar chale nahin gaye, aur agar faujen aa jaayen to tamannaayen karte hain ke kaash! Woh sehra mein baadiya-nasheenon ke saath hote ke tumhari khabren daryaft kiya karte, agar woh tum mein maujood hote (to bhi kya?) na ladte magar baraaye-naam.
ayahs.21: Yaqeenan tumhare liye Rasoolullah mein umda namoona (maujood) hai, har us shakhs ke liye jo Allah Taala ki aur qayamat ke din ki tawaqqu rakhta hai aur ba-kasrat Allah Taala ki yaad karta hai.
ayahs.22: Aur imaan walon ne jab (kuffaar ke) lashkaron ko dekha (be-saakhta) keh uthe! Ke unhi ka waada hamein Allah Taala ne aur us ke Rasool ne diya tha aur Allah Taala aur us ke Rasool ne sach farmaaya, aur is (cheez) ne un ke imaan mein aur shewa-e-farmaan-bardari mein aur izafa kar diya.
ayahs.23: Mominon mein (aise) log bhi hain jinhon ne jo ahd Allah Taala se kiya tha unhein sachcha kar dikhaaya, baaz ne to apna ahd poora kar diya aur baaz (mauqa ke) muntazir hain aur unhon ne koi tabdeeli nahin ki.
ayahs.24: Taake Allah Taala sachchon ko un ki sachchai ka badla de aur agar chaahe to munafiqon ko saza de ya un ki tauba qabool farmaaye, Allah Taala bada hi bakhshne wala bahut hi mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.25: Aur Allah Taala ne kaafiron ko ghusse bhare hue hi (naamuraad) lauta diya unhon ne koi faaida nahin paaya, aur is jang mein Allah Taala khud hi mominon ko kaafi ho gaya Allah Taala badi quwwaton wala aur ghaalib hai.
ayahs.26: Aur jin Ahl-e-Kitaab ne un se saaz-baaz kar li thi unhein (bhi) Allah Taala ne un ke qilon se nikaal diya aur un ke dilon mein (bhi) raub bhar diya ke tum un ke ek giroh ko qatl kar rahe ho aur ek giroh ko qaidi bana rahe ho.
ayahs.27: Aur us ne tumhein un ki zameenon ka aur un ke ghar-baar ka aur un ke maal ka waris kar diya aur us zameen ka bhi jis ko tumhare qadmon ne raunda nahin, Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.28: Ae Nabi! Apni biwiyon se keh do ke agar tum zindagaani-e-dunya aur zeenat-e-dunya chaahti ho to aao main tumhein kuchh de dila doon aur tumhein achchai ke saath rukhsat kar doon.
ayahs.29: Aur agar tumhari muraad Allah aur us ka Rasool aur aakhirat ka ghar hai to (yaqeen maano ke) tum mein se nek kaam karne waliyon ke liye Allah Taala ne bahut zabardast ajr rakh chhode hain.
ayahs.30: Ae Nabi ki biwiyo! Tum mein se jo bhi khuli be-hayaai (ka irtikaab) karegi use dohra dohra azaab diya jaayega, aur Allah Taala ke nazdeek yeh bahut hi sehl (si baat) hai.
ayahs.31: Aur tum mein se jo koi Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki farmaan-bardari karegi aur nek kaam karegi hum use ajr (bhi) dohra denge aur us ke liye hum ne behtareen rozi tayyar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.32: Ae Nabi ki biwiyo! Tum aam auraton ki tarah nahin ho, agar tum parhezgari ikhtiyaar karo to narm lehje se baat na karo ke jis ke dil mein rog ho woh koi bura khayal kare aur haan qaide ke mutabiq kalaam karo.
ayahs.33: Aur apne gharon mein qarar se raho aur qadeem jahiliyat ke zamaane ki tarah apne banaao ka izhaar na karo aur namaz ada karti raho aur zakaat deti raho aur Allah aur us ke Rasool ki ita'at-guzari karo. Allah Taala yehi chaahta hai ke ae Nabi ki ghar-waliyo! Tum se woh (har qism ki) gandagi ko door kar de aur tumhein khoob paak kar de.
ayahs.34: Aur tumhare gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur Rasool ki ahadees padhi jaati hain un ka zikr karti raho, yaqeenan Allah Taala lutf karne wala khabardaar hai.
ayahs.35: Beshak musalman mard aur musalman auraten momin mard aur momin auraten farmaan-bardari karne wale mard aur farmaan-bardaar auraten raast-baaz mard aur raast-baaz auraten sabr karne wale mard aur sabr karne wali auraten, aajizi karne wale mard aur aajizi karne wali auraten, khairaat karne wale mard aur khairaat karne wali auraten, roze rakhne wale mard aur roze rakhne wali auraten apni sharmgah ki hifazat karne wale mard aur hifazat karne waliyan ba-kasrat Allah ka zikr karne wale aur zikr karne waliyan in (sab ke) liye Allah Taala ne (wasee) maghfirat aur bada sawaab tayyar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.36: Aur (dekho) kisi momin mard-o-aurat ko Allah aur us ke Rasool ke faisle ke baad apne kisi amr ka koi ikhtiyaar baaqi nahin rehta, (yaad rakho) Allah Taala aur us ke Rasool ki jo bhi na-farmaani karega woh sareeh gumraahi mein padega.
ayahs.37: (Yaad karo) jabke tu us shakhs se keh raha tha jis par Allah ne bhi in'aam kiya aur tu ne bhi ke tu apni biwi ko apne paas rakh aur Allah se dar aur tu apne dil mein woh baat chhupaaye hue tha jise Allah zaahir karne wala tha aur tu logon se khauf khaata tha, halanke Allah Taala is ka zyada haq-daar tha ke tu us se dare, pas jabke Zaid ne us aurat se apni gharaz poori kar li hum ne use tere nikah mein de diya taake musalmanon par apne le-paalakon ki biwiyon ke baare mein kisi tarah ki tangi na rahe jabke woh apni gharaz un se poori kar len, Allah ka (yeh) hukm to ho kar hi rehne wala tha.
ayahs.38: Jo cheezen Allah Taala ne apne Nabi ke liye muqarrar ki hain un mein Nabi par koi harj nahin, (yehi) Allah ka dastoor un mein bhi raha jo pehle hue aur Allah Taala ke kaam andaaze par muqarrar kiye hue hain.
ayahs.39: Yeh sab aise the ke Allah Taala ke ahkaam pahunchaaya karte the aur Allah hi se darte the aur Allah ke siwa kisi se nahin darte the, aur Allah Taala hisaab lene ke liye kaafi hai.
ayahs.40: (Logo) Tumhare mardon mein se kisi ke baap Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam) nahin lekin aap Allah Taala ke Rasool hain aur tamaam nabiyon ke khatm karne wale, aur Allah Taala har cheez ka (ba-khoobi) jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.41: Musalmano! Allah Taala ka zikr bahut zyada karo.
ayahs.42: Aur subah-o-shaam us ki paakizgi bayan karo.
ayahs.43: Wahi hai jo tum par apni rahmaten bhejta hai aur us ke farishte (tumhare liye dua-e-rahmat karte hain) taake woh tumhein andheron se ujaale ki taraf le jaaye aur Allah Taala mominon par bahut hi mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.44: Jis din yeh (Allah se) mulaaqaat karenge un ka tohfa salaam hoga, un ke liye Allah Taala ne ba-izzat ajr tayyar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.45: Ae Nabi! Yaqeenan hum ne hi aap ko (Rasool bana kar) gawahiyan dene wala, khushkhabriyan sunaane wala, aagah karne wala bheja hai.
ayahs.46: Aur Allah ke hukm se us ki taraf bulaane wala aur roshan chiraagh.
ayahs.47: Aap mominon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye! Ke un ke liye Allah ki taraf se bahut bada fazl hai.
ayahs.48: Aur kaafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna na maaniye! Aur jo eeza (un ki taraf se pahunche) us ka khayal bhi na kijiye Allah par bharosa kiye rahen, aur kaafi hai Allah Taala kaam banaane wala.
ayahs.49: Ae momino! Jab tum momin auraton se nikah karo phir haath lagaane se pehle (hi) talaaq de do to un par tumhara koi haq iddat ka nahin jise tum shumaar karo, pas tum kuchh na kuchh unhein de do aur bhale tareeq par unhein rukhsat kar do.
ayahs.50: Ae Nabi! Hum ne tere liye teri woh biwiyan halaal kar di hain jinhein tu un ka mahr de chuka hai aur woh laundiyan bhi jo Allah Taala ne ghaneemat mein tujhe di hain aur tere chacha ki ladkiyan aur phoopiyon ki betiyan aur tere mamuon ki betiyan aur teri khaalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ne tere saath hijrat ki hai, aur woh ba-imaan aurat jo apna nafs Nabi ko hiba kar de yeh is surat mein ke khud Nabi bhi us se nikah karna chaahe, yeh khaas taur par sirf tere liye hi hai aur mominon ke liye nahin, hum ise ba-khoobi jaante hain jo hum ne un par un ki biwiyon aur laundiyon ke baare mein (ahkaam) muqarrar kar rakhe hain, yeh is liye ke tujh par harj waqe na ho, Allah Taala bahut bakhshne aur bade reham wala hai.
ayahs.51: Un mein se jise tu chaahe door rakh de aur jise chaahe apne paas rakh le, aur agar tu ne un mein se bhi kisi ko apne paas bula le jinhein tu ne alag kar rakha tha to tujh par koi gunah nahin, is mein is baat ki zyada tawaqqu hai ke un auraton ki aankhen thandi rahen aur woh ranjeeda na hon aur jo kuchh bhi tu unhein de de is par sab ki sab raazi rahen. Tumhare dilon mein jo kuchh hai ise Allah (khoob) jaanta hai. Allah Taala bada hi ilm aur hilm wala hai.
ayahs.52: Is ke baad aur auraten aap ke liye halaal nahin aur na yeh (durust hai) ke un ke badle aur auraton se (nikah kare) agarche un ki surat achchi bhi lagti ho magar jo teri mamlooka hon. Aur Allah Taala har cheez ka (poora) nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.53: Ae imaan walo! Jab tak tumhein ijazat na di jaaye tum Nabi ke gharon mein na jaaya karo khaane ke liye aise waqt mein ke us ke pakne ka intizaar karte raho balke jab bulaaya jaaye jaao aur jab kha chuko nikal khade ho, wahin baaton mein mashghool na ho jaaya karo. Nabi ko tumhari is baat se takleef hoti hai. To woh lihaaz kar jaate hain aur Allah Taala (bayan) haq mein kisi ka lihaaz nahin karta, jab tum Nabi ki biwiyon se koi cheez talab karo to parde ke peechhe se talab karo. Tumhare aur un ke dilon ke liye kaamil paakizgi yehi hai, na tumhein yeh jaaiz hai ke tum Rasoolullah ko takleef do aur na tumhein yeh halaal hai ke aap ke baad kisi waqt bhi aap ki biwiyon se nikah karo. (Yaad rakho) Allah ke nazdeek yeh bahut bada (gunah) hai.
ayahs.54: Tum kisi cheez ko zaahir karo ya makhfi rakho Allah to har cheez ka ba-khoobi ilm rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.55: In auraton par koi gunah nahin ke woh apne baapon aur apne beton aur bhaiyon aur bhatijon aur bhanjon aur apni (mel-jol ki) auraton aur milkiyat ke maatihaton (laundi, ghulam) ke saamne hon. (Aurato!) Allah se darti raho. Allah Taala yaqeenan har cheez par shahid hai.
ayahs.56: Allah Taala aur us ke farishte is Nabi par rahmat bhejte hain. Ae imaan walo! Tum (bhi) un par durood bhejo aur khoob salaam (bhi) bhejte raha karo.
ayahs.57: Jo log Allah aur us ke Rasool ko eeza dete hain un par dunya aur aakhirat mein Allah ki phatkaar hai aur un ke liye nihayat ruswa-kun azaab hai.
ayahs.58: Aur jo log momin mardon aur momin auraton ko eeza den baghair kisi jurm ke jo un se sarzad hua ho, woh (bade hi) bohtan aur sareeh gunah ka bojh uthaate hain.
ayahs.59: Ae Nabi! Apni biwiyon se aur apni saahibzaadiyon se aur musalmanon ki auraton se keh do ke woh apne upar apni chaadaren latka liya karen, is se bahut jald un ki shanakht ho jaaya karegi phir na sataai jaayengi, aur Allah Taala bakhshne wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.60: Agar (ab bhi) yeh munafiq aur woh jin ke dilon mein beemari hai aur woh log jo Madeena mein ghalat afwaahen udaane wale hain baaz na aaye to hum aap ko un (ki tabaahi) par musallat kar denge phir to woh chand din hi aap ke saath is (shahr) mein reh sakenge.
ayahs.61: Un par phatkaar barsaai gayi, jahaan bhi mil jaayen pakde jaayen aur khoob tukde tukde kar diye jaayen.
ayahs.62: Un se aglon mein bhi Allah ka yehi dastoor jaari raha. Aur tu Allah ke dastoor mein hargiz radd-o-badal na paayega.
ayahs.63: Log aap se qayamat ke baare mein sawaal karte hain. Aap keh dijiye! Ke is ka ilm to Allah hi ko hai, aap ko kya khabar bahut mumkin hai qayamat bilkul hi qareeb ho.
ayahs.64: Allah Taala ne kaafiron par laanat ki hai aur un ke liye bhadakti hui aag tayyar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.65: Jis mein woh hamesha hamesha rahenge. Woh koi haami-o-madadgaar na paayenge.
ayahs.66: Is din un ke chehre aag mein ulat-palat kiye jaayenge. (Hasrat-o-afsos se) kahenge ke kaash hum Allah Taala aur Rasool ki ita'at karte.
ayahs.67: Aur kahenge ae hamare Rabb! Hum ne apne sardaron aur apne badon ki maani jinhon ne hamein raah-e-raast se bhatka diya.
ayahs.68: Parwardigar tu unhein dugna azaab de aur un par bahut badi laanat naazil farma.
ayahs.69: Ae imaan walo! Un logon jaise na ban jaao jinhon ne Moosa ko takleef di pas jo baat unhon ne kahi thi Allah ne unhein is se bari farma diya, aur woh Allah ke nazdeek ba-izzat the.
ayahs.70: Ae imaan walo! Allah Taala se daro aur seedhi seedhi (sachchi) baaten kiya karo.
ayahs.71: Taake Allah Taala tumhare kaam sanwaar de aur tumhare gunah maaf farma de, aur jo bhi Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taabedari karega us ne badi muraad paa li.
ayahs.72: Hum ne apni amaanat ko aasmanon par zameen par aur pahaadon par pesh kiya lekin sab ne is ke uthaane se inkaar kar diya aur is se dar gaye (magar) insan ne ise utha liya, woh bada hi zaalim jaahil hai.
ayahs.73: (Yeh is liye) ke Allah Taala munafiq mardon auraton aur mushrik mardon auraton ko saza de aur momin mardon auraton ki tauba qabool farmaaye, aur Allah Taala bada hi bakhshne wala aur mehrbaan hai.
